analysis.rationale: R0's single-step YCrCb:2 prediction survives an independent R1 signal re-interpretation. R1 newly inspected the support pairs' global flags that R0 never examined: pairs 1-2 show SATURATION_strengthen_sev5 with saturation_from_noise=false, and pair 3 shows contrast_from_variance (variance_ratio 2.0197) with chroma_ratio 4.6499. Fresh-seed noise-only controls reproduce every one of these values (chroma 1.5285 vs 1.5287 / 1.4508 vs 1.4504, variance 2.0225 vs 2.0197, chroma 4.6531 vs 4.6499) and reproduce the identical false_positive_checks flags, so all global detections are noise+clipping artifacts. Deterministic steps have no supporting signal on any pair (block_boundary 0.9983-1.0040 <1.05, unique_G 256 == clean, spectral_slope_ratio 0.9699-1.0004 <1.08, FFT anisotropy=0, PCA=0; the controls reproduce the slope ratios within 0.2%). Severity is bracketed: sev1 ch_stds [20.8,15.9,23.2] and sev3 [44.1,30.3,49.4] both fail (sigma diff 32%/36%, WEAK) while sev2 matches to 0.1. Subtype: YCrCb signature (ch_stds B>R>G, rgb_ratio 1.5868, cross_ch 0.2994) is not reproducible by magnitude-matched poisson:3 ([22.2,22.1,17.0], cross_ch 0.0012) or RGB:3 (equal channels, cross_ch 0.0131); extreme_pct 51.27%, var_slope 1.0263 and residual_intensity_corr 0.204 are all metric artifacts reproduced by the control. No candidate passes the CHANGE criterion; the noise realization itself remains unverifiable (seed mismatch), so the verdict stays UNCERTAIN.
